answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Every claim climbs the zephyr of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the ferrous re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Reaching the ocean of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
